title: Ron Tototz with Sarge the monkey at hooch T 123
description: Ron Tototz grins in front of hooch T 123 — which Larry says has to be theirs — holding the paw of a small pet monkey named Sarge. Ron hated the monkey, which may have belonged to Jones, the helicopter pilot. The hooch gable is stenciled T 123; reed blinds screen its front, and rows of identical metal-roofed hooches run off behind.
researchNotes: Relayed by Larry's son from Larry's dictation (2026-08-15 session; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0017-c18035388.json and -c18035430.json). 'T 123 has to be their hooch' places Larry and Ron's quarters in a formally numbered building — a matchable datum if building registers for candidate bases (Tân Sơn Nhứt area compounds) survive; VN-0019 shows the same building. 'Jones, the helicopter pilot' vs the PFC Jones of VN-0012/VN-0020 may be one man loosely described or two different Joneses — kept open.
